description: Container image signature verification and registry trust policy.
doc: Configures the per-repository container image verification policy on the device, modeled after containers-policy.json(5). Policies are indexed by `repository_id`, the lowercase hex-encoded SHA-256 hash of the repository scope string.

mappings.description: Target container registry or repository scope.
mappings.doc: The container registry or repository scope to which this policy applies (e.g. `docker.io`, `quay.io/my-org`, or `registry.example.com:5000/team/app`). The path parameter `repository_id` is the lowercase hex-encoded SHA-256 hash of this string, used to key this rule in Astarte.

mappings.description: Policy requirement type for the specified repository.
mappings.doc: Policy requirement applied to images matching the scope defined in `/policy/%{repository_id}/repository`. Allowed values: [Reject, SignedBy].

mappings.description: ID of a stored public key for repository SignedBy verification.
mappings.doc: Optional ID of a trusted public key stored via `io.edgehog.devicemanager.apps.PublicKey` under `/image/signing/%{key_id}` used to verify signatures for images matching the scope defined in `/policy/%{repository_id}/repository` when `type` is `SignedBy`. Ignored if `type` is `Reject`.
